publisher: Oregon DLCD / Oregon Explorer statewide zoning (2023)
filter: ownerName IN ('Baker County','Baker City') AND OBJECTID <> 584
notes: Statewide DLCD zoning (2023), hosted by Oregon Explorer (OSU); covers Baker County and Baker City. Filter excludes OBJECTID 584, one ~50 sq km Secondary Forest 80 polygon whose geometry is invalid in the source, so that polygon is missing from the adapter.
